title: How Citibank Lost $900,000,000 With One Click

beats.text: One click sent nine hundred million dollars to the wrong people.
Three people approved it and nobody stopped it.
It was supposed to be eight million and this is what left the bank.
It was gone before anyone looked up.
And here is the wildest part because when the bank asked for it back a judge said no.
He called it one of the biggest blunders in banking history.
So who clicked and who kept the money and why did the law let them?
This is the nine hundred million dollar click.
The payment leaves at five forty five and nobody notices until morning.
Then the bank asks for its money back and some lenders simply say no.
